articles.title: PM Modi lands in Auckland, greeted by PM Luxon
articles.summary: PM Narendra Modi arrived in Auckland, New Zealand on July 10 for the first official visit by an Indian PM to the nation in four decades, where he will hold bilateral discussions with PM Christopher Luxon.

articles.title: 'Bond with India remains unwavering': PM Modi after meeting diaspora in New Zealand
articles.summary: PM Modi met members of the Indian diaspora in Auckland on July 10, expressing gratitude to the community for their enthusiasm and noting their enduring connection to India after four decades.

articles.title: PM Modi emplanes for Auckland, New Zealand from Melbourne for final leg of his three-nation tour
articles.summary: PM Modi departed Melbourne for Auckland on July 10 after the third India-Australia Annual Summit, concluding his Australia visit with landmark defense and security agreements before proceeding to New Zealand.

articles.title: India aspires to be one of world's top three economies driven by 'Grow more, achieve more' motto: PM Modi
articles.summary: PM Modi addressed the Indian diaspora in Melbourne on July 9, stating India aspires to become one of the world's top three economies driven by the motto 'Grow more, achieve more' and highlighting achievements in 5G and metro infrastructure.

articles.title: PM Narendra Modi receives grand ceremonial welcome in Jakarta
articles.summary: PM Modi arrived in Jakarta, Indonesia on July 7 for an official state visit focused on enhancing strategic cooperation and deepening bilateral relations, including engagement with the Indian diaspora.
